example.content:
const workspaces = await eda.dmt_Workspace.getAllWorkspacesInfo();
const target = workspaces.find((ws) => ws.uuid !== before.uuid) || before;

const toggled = await eda.dmt_Workspace.toggleToWorkspace(target.uuid);
console.log('切换是否成功：', toggled);

const now = await eda.dmt_Workspace.getCurrentWorkspaceInfo();
console.log('切换后工作区：', now.name, 'uuid:', now.uuid);

_source.title: 切换到工作区
_source.example.text.0: 1. 记录切换前的工作区（演示结束后切回，恢复现场）
_source.example.text.1: 2. 获取所有工作区，选一个非当前的作为切换目标；只有当前一个时切换自身
_source.example.text.3: 4. 回读当前工作区，确认已切换到目标
_source.example.text.4: 5. 切回原工作区，恢复现场
_source.params.workspaceUuid: 工作区 UUID，如若不指定，则将切换到个人工作区

title: Switch to workspace
params.workspaceUuid: Workspace UUID. If not specified, it will switch to the personal workspace
returns: Whether the switch operation was successful
